description: Database view exposing density calc measurements data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report density calc measurements records, including amounts and quantities, for the General area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the density calc measurements view.

columns.name: length
columns.description: Length of the density calc measurements.

columns.name: width
columns.description: Width of the density calc measurements.

business_rules: Use length / width for monetary or quantity totals.
Vw_DensityCalcMeasurements is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.

known_issues: Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_DensityCalcMeasurements (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(length) for totals of length.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
